findings.failure_path: the wording-only refusal is gated on args.base, so `--diff-file` + `--wording-only-proof-file` without `--base` is refused nowhere in the packet while the new contract states `--diff-file` alone rejects it and acceptance row A9 is only tested three-way
findings.smallest_fix: drop the `args.base and` condition so any `--diff-file` plus proof-file is refused and add the no-base case to the subject/packet test

findings.failure_path: the empty-candidate guard has no test: deleting it leaves every shown case green and startswith(b"") would bind a receipt to an empty candidate, leaving the acceptance row "empty base-derived candidate is refused" unverified
findings.smallest_fix: add a case with a clean worktree at --base plus a non-empty --diff-file that must fail with the empty-candidate error

concern_results.conclusion: The split is implemented as intended: base_derived_candidate is the old base path extracted unchanged and shared by both modes, the 5-tuple propagates to main/binder/test callers, identified=candidate drives paths and owner selection, the loop variable was renamed so material_candidate_change compares the current candidate, and composite/checkpoint/disposition checks compare candidate-to-candidate; the one logic gap is the base-conditioned wording refusal below.

Prefix anchoring refuses truncated, interleaved, prepended-decoy, and unrelated packets while admitting only strict supersets of the old equality set; the egress secret scan still runs over the whole widened packet and an empty candidate cannot bind; the residual unsafe-adjacent path is `--diff-file` + `--wording-only-proof-file` without `--base`, which the shown code does not refuse despite the new contract saying it is rejected.

Invalid base, non-repo cwd, missing base/diff-file, paths-without-base, empty packet, and empty candidate all refuse closed with messages naming the remedy (append rather than interleave, do not drop hunks); containment failure cannot be bypassed by worktree races since it fails closed; only the no-base wording-proof combination lacks a refusal in the packet.

The new gate cases were added RED-first and are mutation-sensitive (identity collapse and containment removal each red only their owning case, with an honest non-discriminating binder mutation recorded), and the cross-side binder case derives base/paths from candidate_scope rather than hand-building them; however the empty-candidate refusal (acceptance row) and the no-base wording refusal have no test, so deleting either guard stays green.

No-diff-file invocations are byte-exact (candidate == packet, same hashes as today), `--diff-file` alone keeps its meaning, the receipt schema gains no field, the binder's own invocation shape is a verified no-op, and pre-existing receipts keep their meaning since their equality held by construction; both suites are reported green unchanged.

The 0.16.0 bump is consistent across package.json and both lockfile sites that check-release-version.py binds, with release_version_ok reported; nothing migrates, old receipts are not invalidated, and reverting restores equality semantics cleanly.

Receipts now record packet_sha256 and candidate_sha256 separately so an auditor can see what each round read against one candidate; the contract documents the packet-outside-the-tree requirement and `--print-candidate` as the identity authority, and the binder suite asserts the identity the gate recomputes.

As a merge-readiness gate the change cannot land unreviewed bytes: verbatim prefix containment is strictly stronger than the old equality for the reviewer-saw-it property, candidate identity is still compared at succession, chain continuity, completion checkpoint, and dispositions, and only the packet-equals-candidate assertion was relaxed; the two P2 residuals below are the weak points.
